title: 動詞時態
point: 時態題先找時間線索。線索說出動作發生在哪個時間點，動詞形態就跟著決定。
formula: By the time + 主詞 + 過去式動詞，主詞 + had + 過去分詞

parts.text: By the time the new manager arrived,

table.en: yesterday / last week / two days ago
table.rule: 過去某個時間點：過去式 V-ed
從過去延續到現在：have/has + 過去分詞
延續到現在而且還在做：have/has been + V-ing
比過去時間點更早完成：had + 過去分詞

table.en: by next month / by the time it airs
table.zh: 到下個月之前、等它播出時
table.rule: 在未來時間點之前完成：will have + 過去分詞

table.en: once the order arrives, we will call you
table.zh: 訂單一到，我們就會打給你
table.rule: 時間與條件子句講未來用現在式，主句才用 will

examples: By the time the auditors arrived, the accounting team had already closed the books for the quarter.
By the time the shipment reached the port, the customer had canceled half of the order.
story: Mina flew to Osaka for a trade show last Monday.
By the time her flight landed, the exhibition hall had already opened.
Her colleague had set up the booth the night before.
By the time Mina reached the booth, three clients had left their business cards.

drills.prompt: Was the exhibition hall open when Mina's flight landed?
drills.fix: had already opened 表示降落之前展場就開了。

drills.prompt: Did the clients leave their cards before or after Mina reached the booth?
drills.fix: had left 的動作比 reached 更早發生，所以是之前。

drills.prompt: By the time Mina sat down, her colleague ___ lunch for both of them.
drills.fix: sat down 是過去的時間點，比它更早完成的事用 had + 過去分詞。
